standalone_browser_tests.scope: Synthetic standalone local Chromium DOM fixtures, not installed Home Assistant Lit components

test_network_scope: Disposable loopback fixtures only; no real HA, controller, broker, manufacturer or observed VM requests
monitor_permission: homeassistant_api solely for Supervisor-provided notification credential; no user long-lived token, Supervisor-management, host, Docker or public ports
monitor_transport: Verified HTTPS to dedicated health-only endpoint using original SNI/Host and optional connect IP; fixed internal Supervisor HA persistent_notification endpoint only
outbox: Private durable bounded64-event at-least-once stable-ID queue; healthy first baseline silent; corrupt/full state refuses without erasure
limits: Actual new-version container build, Supervisor permission/token delivery, app upgrade, notification commissioning and authenticated installed-native HA frontend acceptance are not established by these tests
Missing heartbeat evidence means unknown, not heater outage
HA-host/Core outage prevents its own notifications
Physical or end-to-end heating response is not established by model/loopback tests
coverage_migration: tests/COVERAGE-MIGRATION.md; all advertised model/browser entrypoints executed; existing combined tests README preserved
